meta.definition: Workers whose primary job is in a job centre (a town or Census community with at least 1,000 primary jobs) and whose modelled drive from home to that centre passes the town (a road point inside its boundary or within 200 m). Homes in the town or the centre, and trips under 5 or over 75 straight-line miles, are left out.
meta.route_model: Shortest free-flow time on TIGER/Line roads, speed by road class: S1100 65 mph, S1200 50 mph, S1400 25 mph, S1630 35 mph, S1640 20 mph, S1740 15 mph. Times are free-flow, so real peak and winter drives run longer.
meta.metro_note: Towns, homes and job centres in these five metro areas are not counted: nearly every trip there crosses some suburb, so a through count would not mean anything.
meta.renter_share_source: https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5/profile DP04_0047PE (renter-occupied share), home counties weighted by workers; read from data/hna/summary/<county>.json
meta.use: A pool of workers who might move closer to their job, never demand by itself. A market study can add part of it to demand only with comparable-property evidence of tenants moving in (CHFA 2027-28 QAP, Market Study Guide, In-migration).
meta.limits: LODES assigns some jobs to an employer's main office rather than the worksite, blurs home locations for privacy, and is about two years old when published. Earnings bands are per job, not household income.
